topics.topic: Repair-view query contract-version source: which owned read returns all versions for a slot (with order) so Surface can deterministically page/filter NodeExecutions
questions: How does `surface` select those NodeExecutions deterministically, given M23 has no `contract_version_id` field to filter on?
What owned read capability returns the set of contract versions for a slot (needed before paging NodeExecutions), and in what order?

topics.topic: Authority for enforcing and proving release-time dependency pinning
questions: Which module or non-runtime component is authoritative for enforcing and evidencing 'dependencies pinned by release' so implementations do not diverge silently?

topics.topic: Execution-class masking source: derivable from trace/value data alone or requires bindings lookup at read time
questions: Is execution-class masking intended to be derivable from trace/value records alone, or must `surface` depend on `bindings` lookups at read time?

topics.topic: Ownership of writing StoredValue records/value bytes when capturing trial inputs from failed runs
questions: When capture creates trial inputs from a failed run (especially file fixtures), which module owns writing the StoredValue records and bytes: `runs`, `functions`, or both?

topics.topic: Refused-run finalization atomicity: same write as refusal NodeExecution vs deferred reconciliation
questions: Must ending a run as `refused` be atomic in the same write as the refusal NodeExecution, or may it be deferred to a later `runs` call/recovery?

topics.topic: Run inspection read path: must Surface use runs.read_run (computed reasons) or may it read raw run records from store
questions: For inspect/list of runs, must `surface` read runs through `runs.read_run` (to include computed output reasons) or may it page raw run records from `store`?

topics.topic: Single owner of NodeExecution invariants when multiple modules can write NodeExecution records
questions: Who is the single owner of global NodeExecution invariants (exactly-once record per concluded attempt, field-shape checks, and ordering guarantees) when two modules write the same record type?
